# Project Setup

source('https://inkaverse.com/setup.r')

# Data import

```{r}
gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1VN0X6mcPoxDPoT_UZLsGFBOpOptBLTQxihEMyfP1n5I/edit?gid=433364286#gid=433364286" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

gs

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "organizado") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:5), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()
```

# Boxplot

```{r}
plot_raw(data = fb, x = "temp", y = "grados_brix"
         , group = "cultivo")
```

```{r}
fb %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = temp, y = pH, fill = cultivo)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.8,
    outlier.shape = 21
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperatura",
    y = "pH",
    fill = "Cultivo"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```
